motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council INSTRUCT the City Tourism Department, with assistance from the Bureau of Street Services, to report back on the following information: Scope of the proposed interactive kiosk program relative to (C.F. 22-1154-S1); Assessment to identify the appropriate City agency to manage and administer the Request for Proposal (RFP) and the interactive kiosk program; Regulatory framework and spatial requirements for kiosk installation; and Estimated annual revenue projections and fiscal impacts to the Sidewalk and Transit Amenities Program (STAP). I FURTHER MOVE that the Council INSTRUCT the City Tourism Department, with assistance from thei City Attorney and any other relevant department, to initiate the environmental review process for the City’s consideration of the proposed kiosk program.
